Audit note

Three parameters were reviewed and corrected before publication:

  1. Coffee unit cost restated from $0.35 to $0.85 once the correct comparator, the office machine rather than the one at home, was identified.
  2. Baked-goods conversion rate held at 0% after re-verification. The figure is correct.
  3. The ranking in Exhibit 01 was re-checked and remains based exclusively on data reported by the candidate.

Method is identical in structure to the CRVS investment case on tab 03, where the same rule refuses to credit one shared input with the whole outcome. Applied consistently, it does this to me. The difference is that every parameter in that model has a source.

Sensitivity: relaxing the attribution rule to 100% returns US$4.62 per dollar, which is the figure the CRVS model produces for civil registration. I am choosing to read that as validation.
